title: Go-Fiber SMTP API Gateway
subtitle: High-performance SMTP API built with GoFiber
description: A high-performance SMTP API Gateway that enables direct mail delivery to MX relay servers, bypassing traditional MTAs. Engineered custom SMTP communication using net/textproto and enmime, with soft‑retry mechanisms, real‑time connection monitoring, optional DKIM signing, and containerized deployment via Docker.

modularInfrastructure.title: Layered Routing
modularInfrastructure.description: Separate routing layers for authentication, validation, and email dispatch to keep concerns isolated.

modularInfrastructure.title: Middleware Stack
modularInfrastructure.description: Custom middlewares for rate limiting, logging, and DKIM signing are composed in a clear stack order.

architectureHighlights.title: Custom SMTP Communication
architectureHighlights.description: Implemented low‑level SMTP commands using net/textproto, allowing granular handling of server responses and raw status codes.

architectureHighlights.title: Soft‑Retry & Monitoring
architectureHighlights.description: Automatic retry logic with configurable attempts and delays, plus real‑time connection health monitoring for high deliverability.

architectureHighlights.title: DKIM Signing
architectureHighlights.description: Optional DKIM signing of outgoing mail via configurable private key, improving inbox placement and protecting against spoofing.

prerequisites: An accessible SMTP server for testing

setupAndRun.description: Set SERVER_PORT, AUTH_SECRET, LOG_*, MAIL_*, DKIM_*, etc.

setupAndRun.step: Or build and run via Docker
setupAndRun.command: docker build -t gofiber-smtp-server . && docker run -p 8080:8080 -e SERVER_PORT=8080 -e AUTH_SECRET=my-secret gofiber-smtp-server

routes.description: Returns {"status":"ok"} if the service is running.
Send an email via the SMTP gateway. Requires Auth-Token header and JSON payload with to/from/subject/text_body/html_body.
